why: NOTES-FROM-PLANNING.md entry 171 section 6, closing request 8. A sample over about 10 MB is attached to the test-data
release as a download and never committed, so nothing is added to any clone, ever. CI fetches each file by URL and verifies
its SHA-256 with scripts/test-data.py before a test uses it. The release is created once by ci.yml, not by the nightly, so
nothing that rewrites or prunes nightly releases touches it. Each file names the consent record that lets it be published.
